2011. Payment System Using Interface

60

Medium

Problem Statement

Create an interface Payment with a method pay(int amount).

Create three classes:

UPI
Card
Cash

Each class should implement the pay() method and print the corresponding payment method and amount.
input_spec:
The first line contains the payment method: upi, card, or cash.

The second line contains the payment amount.
output_spec: Print the payment method and amount.
